verdict.rationale: Twenty supports scoping API keys to a role via Settings → Members → Roles → Assignment, limiting what an API key (usable by an agent) can access, and separately allows assigning specific roles to AI agents to control exactly what data/actions they can access. This directly matches least-privilege credential issuance for agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of API key scoping in practice, and finer-grained per-field/per-record key scoping details.
